de: On the night of November 11 in Adygea repelled the attack of Ukrainian drones. In the village of New Adygea, Takhtamukai district, the wreckage of the UAV caused the fire of the roof of a five-storey house. Details - in the material aif.ru.

te: Zakharova reacted to the refusal of the Prime Minister of Denmark to negotiate with Russia
de: Zakharova, commenting on the words of Danish Prime Minister Frederiksen, offered Europe a way to choose a representative for negotiations with Russia.

te: More than 10 drones neutralized in the sky over the Pskov region
de: The governor of the Pskov region urged residents to be attentive and report the fall of the UAV or its debris to the emergency services.

de: Head of the Department for New Challenges and Threats of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation Petr Ilyichev said about the growing terrorist threat from Kiev.
